eswatini/mlilwane.name: Mlilwane Wildlife Sanctuary
eswatini/mlilwane.description: Eswatini first protected area, where you can walk, cycle or ride among zebra, giraffe and hippo.
eswatini/mlilwane.details: Mlilwane has no large predators, so visitors can explore on foot, on mountain bikes and on horseback. A sunset game drive with drinks and a hippo walk are popular. Rest camps have rondavel huts. It is about 30 minutes from Mbabane.

eswatini/mantenga-cultural.name: Mantenga Cultural Village and falls
eswatini/mantenga-cultural.description: A living museum of Swazi traditions with dance, beehive huts and a nearby waterfall.
eswatini/mantenga-cultural.details: Mantenga recreates a traditional village with dance performances and explanations of customs. A short walk leads to the Mantenga Falls. It lies in the Ezulwini Valley, the heart of the tourism area.

eswatini/swazi-candles.name: Swazi Candles and Malkerns crafts
eswatini/swazi-candles.description: A craft centre where handmade candles, glass and weaving are made in front of you.
eswatini/swazi-candles.details: Swazi Candles makes wax animals and patterned candles, and nearby studios produce recycled glass at Ngwenya and baskets in Malkerns. It is a cultural addition rather than a wildlife stop. Best visited May to September on dry days.

eswatini/malolotja.name: Malolotja Nature Reserve
eswatini/malolotja.description: A high mountain reserve of waterfalls, trails and a canopy tour, with blue wildebeest and zebra.
eswatini/malolotja.details: Malolotja has a 95-metre waterfall, hiking trails and a series of ziplines through the forest. Chalets and camps offer a quiet stay. The weather is cooler at altitude, so bring layers. It lies in the north-west near the South African border.

eswatini/hlane.name: Hlane Royal National Park
eswatini/hlane.description: The largest park in Eswatini, with lions, elephants, white rhinos and a waterhole viewing hide.
eswatini/hlane.details: Hlane is the main big-game park and has one of the largest white rhino populations. Open vehicle drives and walking safaris are offered, and rest camp bungalows overlook waterholes. The park is hot in summer.

eswatini/mkhaya.name: Mkhaya Game Reserve
eswatini/mkhaya.description: A private reserve for rhinos, with 4x4 safaris and a rustic stone cottage camp.
eswatini/mkhaya.details: Mkhaya is a conservation reserve for black and white rhino and rare antelope, and visitors are collected by game viewing vehicle. Stays are in a bush camp with no electricity. Prices include meals and activities, and booking ahead is required.

eswatini/swazi-market.name: Manzini and Mbabane craft markets
eswatini/swazi-market.description: Colourful town markets for fruit, woven goods and textiles.
eswatini/swazi-market.details: The Manzini market is a busy place for produce and everyday goods, and Mbabane has a craft market near the town centre. Haggle politely. The Ezulwini craft centres sell grass baskets and wood carvings.

eswatini.name: Eswatini
eswatini.description: A small kingdom of mountains, culture and easy wildlife viewing.
